caption: The drawing depicts a detailed technical illustration of a handheld stamp or seal. The main object in the center of the composition has a rounded, wooden handle colored in light brown with visible grain texture, attached to a silver or metallic base. Below it, there is an oval-shaped bottom view of the base, featuring ornate, floral-like engravings surrounding a central slot. Surrounding the main object and below it are three smaller, technical line drawings showing the object from different perspectives: the leftmost drawing is a flat, top-down outline of the oval base with measurements, the center drawing gives a top-down and side view of the entire object with additional dimensions, and the rightmost drawing shows a side profile of the stamp with the handle and base. Labels for measurements and a line labeled "Scale: 1-In" are present. The background is plain, off-white, and the central drawings are enclosed in a rectangular border. The overall style is precise and functional, suitable for technical or industrial documentation.
title: Pewter Stamp
